messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Varuna-prod (VPC eu1) dedicated pool 'varuna-eu1-pool' exceeded latency SLO
incident-bot: metrics snapshot: p95=3.7s (SLO 1.5s), p99=9.2s; error rate within baseline; traffic +2.8x in last 10m
incident-bot: dashboard: https://console.redwood/obs/varuna-eu1-pool runbook: /incidents/playbooks/tenant-isolation
oncall-eng: I'm oncall, starting triage. Paging SRE + ML infra. @sre-lead @ml-infra
sre-lead: here, tagging SE/CSM for customer comms: @se-alex @csm-lucia
ml-infra: quick tail of model servers shows repeated long-context rerank requests from tenant varuna-org (avg prompt ~18k tokens). KV cache growing then evicting.
ml-infra: looks like KV thrash causing backend stalls on GPUs. @oncall-eng can you grab heap traces and node mem stats?
oncall-eng: running commands now:
````rdctl logs --tenant varuna-org --pool varuna-eu1-pool --since 5m | grep -E "KVCache|evict|gc"
rdctl top --pool varuna-eu1-pool
```
oncall-eng: results: KV eviction spike correlated with client surge, memory pressure on varu-3, load concentrated on nodes varu-1..3 (3/6 nodes).
se-alex: Varuna ops confirmed a recent push that increases rerank context lengths. They expected quantized model to handle it. Customer impact: interactive chat latency high; client timeouts reported at ~10s; ~10k active sessions visible.
sre-lead: short-term mitigation plan: 1) isolate varuna-org traffic to limited burst capacity; 2) enforce tenant rate + max-context caps; 3) shift non-interactive/batch traffic to warm-spare pool; 4) provision extra node if needed. We'll execute in that order.
oncall-eng: applying step 1+2 now.
oncall-eng: applying tenant cap:
````rdctl tenant update varuna-org --rate-limit 15rps --max-context 8k
```
deploy-bot: /apply config varuna-org-ratecap v1.2 queued on control plane
deploy-bot: rollout started to routing layer (canary 10% -> 100%)
oncall-eng: canary applying to 10% traffic, monitoring metrics
sre-lead: step 3: move eligible traffic to warm-spare pool varuna-eu1-warm. @eng-runtime can you authorize and move non-interactive routes first?
eng-runtime: authorized. moving batch/non-critical routes first.
eng-runtime: routing command issued:
````rdctl route move --tenant varuna-org --from varuna-eu1-pool --to varuna-eu1-warm --predicate "route != /interactive"
```
ml-infra: spinning warm nodes (2 GPUs) for varuna-eu1-warm; ETA ~6m. Will prime KV caches to avoid cold fills.
sre-lead: CSM/SE: prepare customer-facing note. Short outage window + mitigation steps + ETA.
csm-lucia: drafting to Varuna ops: "We detected a latency spike tied to long-context reranking. We isolated your tenant, applied temporary rate/context caps, and are shifting non-interactive work to a warm spare. Expect stabilization in ~10–12 minutes. Will update in 5m." Send now? :email:
se-alex: send now. Add X-request-id header example for tracing: X-Req-Varuna: ${trace}
oncall-eng: 5m metrics update: p95 -> 2.0s, p99 -> 4.6s. varu-3 still shows high mem usage but overall pool pressure decreased.
ml-infra: warm nodes are up. Priming KV cache now to reduce load on varu-3.
ml-infra: prime command (one-off):
````rdctl prime-cache --pool varuna-eu1-warm --model rerank-v2 --prefixes /varuna/top-100
```
oncall-eng: after priming: p95=1.3s, p99=1.9s, error rates stable. Mitigation effective. Keeping rate caps until post-incident review.
sre-lead: agree. Maintain caps for 2 hours, then gradual rollback if RCAs clear. Creating incident ticket and assigning follow-ups. I'll own the incident: INC-2026-0457.
sre-lead: follow-ups:
- ML infra: analyze KV eviction patterns & model memory usage
- Eng-runtime: add auto-shed rule for oversized-context tenants
- SE: provide Varuna configuration best-practices
- CSM: customer message + timeline
oncall-eng: note: observed secondary config bug where prefix cache ignored tenant max-context; filing CFG-1349.
csm-lucia: customer message sent at 2026-03-17T15:12Z; Varuna acknowledged and requested a short summary for their logs.
se-alex: will draft mitigation timeline and recommended workload changes for the customer.
sre-lead: warboard closed for now; monitoring continues. Re-open if p95 > 1.5s or p99 > 3s.
oncall-eng: final snapshot @+20m: p95=1.4s, p99=1.9s, traffic normalized. Marking last update.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0457 created and linked https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0457
sre-lead: thanks all. Postmortem draft in #postmortems/INC-2026-0457 in 72h :memo:
